intent: What an agent intends to do, before or during a run. People edit, accept, run, skip, stop, or retry steps.
useWhen: an agent proposes several steps and the person should accept or edit them first
show which planned step runs now and which need approval
a compact one-line plan summary in a chat
doNotUseWhen: what already happened in a run — AgentTrail
a single action that needs an OK — ApprovalCard
wizard steps a person fills in — ProgressSteps
a to-do list without an agent — ListView

steps.note: { id, label, tool?, target?, note?, needsApproval?, error? }[]

status.note: drafting shows skeleton rows; draft with no steps shows Empty.

currentStepId.note: running: the step that runs now. failed: the step that stopped.

summary.note: Default derived: "5 steps · 2 need approval", "5 steps · 2 done · 1 waiting".

footerNote.note: Mono note in the footer, e.g. "accepted 14:02" or "3 of 5 · 1m 48s".

editable.note: Draft only, and only with onChange: per-step Edit / Remove and Add step.

onChange.note: (steps) => void. Called after Save step, Remove, and Add step.

onAccept.note: Draft footer: Accept plan, the view's one solid primary. ⌘/Ctrl+Enter inside the card.

onRun.note: Accepted footer: Run (outline). ⌘/Ctrl+Enter inside the card.

onViewTrail.note: Complete footer: open the run's AgentTrail.

onCollapsedChange.note: (collapsed) => void. Adds the show / hide chevron.

requirements: steps are an ordered list; the current or failed step has aria-current=step
Edit and Remove are icon-only kit Buttons named with the step
the step form is a form named "Edit step N"; Escape cancels, Enter saves
⌘/Ctrl+Enter accepts a draft or runs an accepted plan while focus is in the card
the collapse chevron is a button with aria-expanded
row and marker motion is opacity and transform only, off under prefers-reduced-motion

doNot: Do not invent a local AgentPlan, PlanCard, or StepEditor
Accept plan is the one solid primary; Run is outline
Do not show Edit / Remove once the plan is accepted
Do not use raw hex; approval uses caution tokens
Do not use AgentPlan for what already happened (AgentTrail)
snippet: <AgentPlan title="Fix invoice rounding" status="draft" steps={steps} onChange={setSteps} onAccept={accept} />
